display_name: Mars suit, helmet off under the filtered canopy or in the command shelter
_canon_basis: CH01: Aven 'approached with her helmet off'; Thane 'helmet off, letting the dry Martian air tug gently at his hair under the filtered canopy'; Galen sets his helmet on the 'anchor mount beside the entry' of the command shelter.

reference_images.label: Approved Mars surface suit (shown on Galen, helmet sealed)
reference_images.instruction: this is the SAME suit with only the helmet removed and carried: keep the metal neck ring, hard torso shell, chest display unit, harness, backpack, fabric, orange piping and insignia exactly; the face and name come from the wearer's own references

reference_images.label: Approved helmet-off configuration under the canopy (shown on Galen)
reference_images.instruction: match how the suit looks with the helmet off: exposed empty neck ring, lit chest unit, backpack on, helmet carried at the side, filtered canopy overhead; face and name come from the wearer's own references
